recap.headline: Acinonyx Picked Itself First, Plays Like Last
recap.subhead: Eshan B promised a title and a bag of Fritos, then benched 28 points and lost the night 4-6.

zingers.line: Eshan B picked himself first and sits seventh, then benched Devin Vassell's 21 points and 3 steals while Austin Reaves bricked 6-16.
Andrew Nembhard dropped 18 points on the bench while this team tied three categories with White Mambas, and the manager apparently watched.
Terrence Shannon Jr. put up 19 on the bench, and Nova still went 9-1-1 because Wembanyama did all the work.
Stephen Curry hung 44 points and 6 threes, and theInfamous still went 1-9-1 on the night, which takes real talent.
Yaxel Lendeborg shot 11-20 for 26 points and Franz Wagner went 4-11, and the league's top-ranked team survived MONSTARS only by a thread.
Unluckiest team in the league at minus 0.264, and Kris Dunn is the only reason last night wasn't worse.
Got hammered 8-2-1 by Thug Life, slid two spots in the rankings, and won exactly one category: turnovers, by committing eleven.

night: Stephen Curry (theInfamous) went for 44 PTS, 8 REB, 6 AST and 6 3PTM, the best line of the night, and his team still lost 9-1-1 to Nova.
Austin Reaves (Acinonyx) shot 6-16 for 16 PTS, the worst brick of a night that sank Acinonyx to 4-6-1 against LeParth James.
Devin Vassell (Acinonyx) scored 21 PTS with 3 STL on 8-18 FG while sitting on the bench, with Daniel Gafford's 11 REB idle beside him.
Jalen Smith went 17 PTS, 11 REB, 3 3PTM and 3 BLK, and he is still on the wire, as are Derrick Jones Jr. and Kingston Flemings.
Nova Knicks won the night 9-1-1 over theInfamous, with Wembanyama's 36 PTS, 14 REB and 3 STL. Acinonyx lost worst at 4-6-1 against LeParth James.
